- OCCT GeomLProp_SLProps (LProp_Status::Undefined) (uncovered class evidence)

## Description

A surface property query (tangent in U, V, or normal) at a specific UV parameter returns "undefined" because the surface partial derivatives vanish there (a pole, a degenerate corner). Bug-reporter language: "surface tangent undefined", "normal not computable", "pole on surface".

## Reproducer recipe

An `SPHERICAL_SURFACE`; query the U-tangent at `v = π/2` (the pole). The U-tangent is zero.

## Expected kernel behavior

Return the undefined status to the caller; do not return a NaN or arbitrary unit vector.

## Notes

Common cause of NaN propagation when the caller assumes Defined. Bytes alone are insufficient to demonstrate this defect — needs sibling input fixture. Tagged provenance_tier: runtime-only.
